summary: Read the five-voter receipt (14e86faf6ccc4b13af3ee46c65cc08dc, exit 0, test passed) and found all three comparisons complete and holding, so the starvation signature reproduces when the follower is one of five voters with the leader retaining a majority of healthy followers: the premise recorded a cached claim at index 102 in term 2 over an installed snapshot at 83 in term 3, and the probe again showed repeated installs at an unchanged snapshot index, the follower's applied index fixed while the frontier advanced, and the claim persisting with its suffix kept. The parent account is therefore updated to cite that receipt, to record the tested voter counts (three and five), and to drop the three-voter limitation; its counterevidence and the repair boundary (claim 97, snapshot 98, follower restored to the frontier) remain as they were. To close the last gap in the same account the driver now also runs the decided trimmed case with a ten-second window, which is the only difference from the settled three-second case, with the three established assertions scoped to that tag; a local construction run shows the follower still fixed at 83 while the frontier advanced from 83 to 123 with restores 5 -> 4883 and one stable leader set, but that is construction feedback and the retained receipt is requested here. Remaining unmeasured: a production BoltDB-style store is not available in the captured package, and the child question's minority bound still assumes no configuration change between the orphaned suffix and the snapshot install.
